Descriptions

Bring smooth performance and ample storage to your everyday routine with this 5G Smartphone. You get a big, 6.87 in screen that’s smooth and bright, thanks to its 120Hz refresh rate and 1020-nit brightness, so everything from scrolling through messages to watching videos looks sharp, even in sunlight. The Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 octa-core chip and 8GB of RAM keep everything running fast, whether you’re jumping between apps or multitasking. With 256GB of storage, there’s plenty of room for your photos and apps. It’s built for speed too. 5G keeps you connected, the massive 8100mAh battery powers long days, and stereo speakers make watching movies or listening to playlists a lot more fun.
